description: A bounded-spend mandate for an autonomous agent that purchases paid resources (search APIs, licensed data, compute) to complete a task. Each receipt records ONE resource_purchased action, capped at the bound max_amount per purchase in the bound currency, and confined to the bound allowed_categories. amount is bounded [0, max_amount], so a purchase over the per-purchase cap is nonconformant (and a negative max_amount ceiling yields an empty range, failing closed); category must be one of allowed_categories, so a purchase in an unbudgeted category is nonconformant; currency is pinned to the bound currency. Evidence is closed (additionalProperties:false) so no unmodeled field rides along. The verifier enforces the shape and these bound bounds, not the meaning of the free-text resource/purchase_id/task_ref fields — populating them with opaque references rather than sensitive payloads is the integrator's contract. Each purchase is its own single-action chain, so a spend statement is a set of independently verifiable receipts and the aggregate task budget is enforced by the presenter, not sealed per receipt.
